title: MERRY CHRISTMAS
desc: Holiday wishes from the Washington Roleplay team.
body:
Happy Christmas to @everyone.

We wish you joy, peace, and good health during this holiday season. Thank you for being part of our community — your support, dedication, and time truly matter to us.

May these holidays give you the chance to relax, recharge, and spend meaningful moments with your family and friends. Please take care and stay safe.

We look forward to continuing our journey together and making even more progress in the days ahead.

Merry Christmas 🎄

WASHINGTON ROLEPLAY

:WCRP:
